text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Logo-san♪ How did you 
like... our present?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if they enjoyed the pickled 
plums?

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Yes. They were thoroughly sun-dried and 
had such a smooth texture—

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
The salt had seeped thoroughly into the 
plum, giving it a rich, mellow flavor. 
It's been quite a while since I've had an 
umeboshi like that.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness~! It was totally worth the 
effort we both put into making it, 
Tarumae♪

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text: Oho— ...Just the two of you? Really?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes, I just thought Logo-san might be 
happier with something handmade...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Pickled plums ward off evil spirits and 
bring good luck, so they're perfect for 
milestone days too♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Still, was it a bit too plain after all? 
It's not really anything grand, after 
all...

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
You must have spent so much time on this. 
...Just knowing that makes me happier than 
anything.
